posts.headline: Midjourney V7 Generates Photorealistic Videos Now

slide_1.label: BREAKING
slide_1.title: Midjourney V7: Get Real Videos Now!
slide_1.subtitle: Create 30-sec photorealistic videos from text. It's wild!

slide_2.title: Here's The Scoop
slide_2.bullet_1: Midjourney V7 now creates photorealistic videos.

slide_3.title: Video AI: What Is It?
slide_3.simple_explanation: It's AI that turns your written ideas into moving pictures. Imagine typing 'a cat flying a spaceship' and seeing it happen. No cameras needed, just your words.
slide_3.analogy: Like magic, but with code. Your words become a mini-movie.

slide_4.title: Why This Is HUGE For YOU
slide_4.impact_statement: Professional video production is now available to everyone.
slide_4.for_students: Make cool project videos or creative shorts easily.
slide_4.for_employees: Quickly create engaging content for presentations or internal comms.
slide_4.for_business: Produce high-quality marketing videos without big budgets.

slide_5.title: Your Text To Video - How?
slide_5.step_1: Type your detailed prompt in Midjourney.
slide_5.step_2: Midjourney's V7 model processes your text.
slide_5.fun_fact: It's all happening inside Discord, where you already use MJ!

slide_6.title: How YOU Can Use This Today
slide_6.use_case_1: Students: Animate your stories for class projects.
slide_6.use_case_2: Employees: Create explainer videos for your team.
slide_6.use_case_3: Businesses: Develop quick ads for social media.
slide_6.use_case_4: Creators: Prototype film ideas or make unique shorts.

slide_7.title: The Good & The 'Needs Work'
slide_7.pro_1: Super easy to create videos, just using text.
slide_7.con_1: Videos are currently limited to 30 seconds.
slide_7.con_2: Fine-tuning complex scenes might be tricky.

slide_8.title: The Bigger Picture: Video AI
slide_8.context: Midjourney V7 pushes the boundaries of text-to-video. It means high-quality video creation is no longer just for pros. This is a huge leap forward.
slide_8.vs_before: Expensive studios and complex software needed for good videos.
slide_8.vs_now: Your words are enough to make pro-level video content.

slide_9.title: Pro Tips To Get Started
slide_9.tip_1: Be super descriptive in your text prompts.
slide_9.tip_2: Experiment with different camera angles and lighting.
slide_9.tip_3: Use reference images to guide your video style.
slide_9.bonus_tip: Combine with other AI tools for voiceovers and music!

slide_10.title: The Bottom Line
slide_10.summary: Midjourney V7 is democratizing pro-level video creation for everyone.
